schema: CREATE TABLE molecules ( id INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT ); CREATE TABLE atoms ( id INT PRIMARY KEY, molecule_id INT, element TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (molecule_id) REFERENCES molecules(id) );
correct_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) FROM molecules m JOIN atoms a ON m.id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'Carbon'
